text:
Maya (Product): quick sync on spend card compact variant I uploaded to Figma. goal: make token breakdown scannable without extra hover on desktop. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzz
Tess (Design Ops): mocked two variants: 1) tiny numeric pills inline with sparkline, 2) pill shown only on expand. attaching images in file comments.
Sam (PM): growth prefers inline pills for conversion. mobile is tight though.
Leo (Eng): perf callout: rendering pills for thousands of rows spikes paint time. we should send aggregated counts and render lightweight SVG/text, avoid heavy DOM per cell.
Anya (A11y): definitely avoid hover-only reveals. keyboard focus must surface the same pills, and ARIA labels are needed for the sparkline and pill groups. ensure contrast meets 4.5:1 for small text.
Maya (Product): proposal: desktop = pills visible; mobile = pills on tap/expand; keyboard = focus reveals. copy tweak: change "Estimated monthly spend" -> "Monthly cost estimate".
John (Revenue): reminder: CSV/export mapping must reflect visible numbers. customers need token_id, model, tokens, cost_usd columns.
Dev-bot: preview build #489 pushed with aggregated pill rendering: https://preview.redwood/branch/spend-compact-489
Leo (Eng): implementation note: precompute 7-point aggregates to keep sparkline cheap; lazy-init tooltips.
Anya (A11y): sample aria snippet to include: <svg role="img" aria-label="30-day cost trend: up 8%"></svg> and wrap pill group in role="group" with aria-label summary.
Tess (Design Ops): I'll adjust contrast tokens and upload a condensed mobile flow by EOD.
Maya (Product): plan: finalize desktop/mobile behavior, update Figma copy, Eng to run perf checks on low-end devices, John to review CSV schema when drafted. I'll post a Loom after mocks land. :white_check_mark:
